title: Decoding Complications: Large Language Model-Based Classification of Free-Text Entries in Clinical Stroke Registries
summary: The primary source Methods/Results confirm the represented result: An LLM-guided taxonomy classifies 9,146 free-text stroke-registry adverse-event entries, with frozen GPT-5.4 labels matching clinician consensus on 300 held-out entries (weighted F1 96.5%) and recovering 19.6% more adverse-event instances than structured fields.
